notes.title: Version 1.0.23 released
notes.content:
Fixed bug where the level never ends if the last enemy alive is a bomber, and that bomber escapes.
Fixed bug where the HUD’s “Enemies Detected” count could be incorrect.

notes.title: Version 1.0.22 released
notes.content: Fixes a bug where the player's fighter can slide backwards after spawning on the carrier, potentially damaging it (or at least scratching up the paint job).

notes.title: Xenoform released!
notes.content:
Xenoform is now released and available for purchase.

But I [i]highly[/i] recommend playing the free demo first; this game isn't for everyone, so try before you buy!
